evidence.note: City record 714471 is the connected union of Batts, Mezes and Benedict (official overlap 19/48/19%). One hipped clay-tile volume per building on its official polygon (Mezes split into north bar, south bar and west wing; tier = LiDAR median inside each piece: 18.4, 17.3 and 21.0 m. The north bar is mixed in the LiDAR: a 21.0 m east strip, 17.3-18.4 m west half and an 11.8 m strip on its west side; one hipped volume at the median is a compromise). Ridge = tier + 0.4 x rise (tier = median of the pitched piece; calibrated so the built roof median meets the LiDAR median), rise from the measured 24 deg pitch. Tile is from a secondary source (six red-roofed buildings) and matches the LiDAR pitch; eave brackets and the Benedict-Mezes infill (3D/I 2006) are not modelled separately. Pending b05-r1: the record is suppressed (route) by mall-buildings yard soil until the soil is clipped.
